criteria: Retain and classify every former missing source separately: insufficient overlap of fullframe car, other-class output, detector suppressing source below .01 cannot be diagnosed without its logits. Preserve exact baseline detection/assignment once comparator settings are verified.

On eight fresh validation videos, fixed second-pass tiling recovers at least one reference object omitted by baseline and paired per-video availability increases with 95% lower bound >0; do not remove already matched baseline boxes. Confirm recovered objects by separate future full-mask tracking at IoU>=.50, same SAM memory, no changes to thresholds.

Report the number of extra *unmatched* boxes and duplicates per frame and detector cost. No automatic deployment or free improvement if candidate burden grows. Retrospective oracle box assignment is not a runtime identity rule.
selection: Previously missing source mechanism diagnosed on known21 pairs. Independent next8 MOTS val videos disjoint from original12 and archived20. At official frame indices49/149 use exact same rule: car with >=512 pixels highest prior box overlap, then nearest competing car by overlap/area/ID. Hold out all reference and query results until selection. No reselect if no car pair.
variants: Frozen YOLO26s at960 .01, confidence and NMS thresholds unchanged. A full frame class-car baseline; B full frame all classes (separate class membership from baseline class-filter influence); C full frame plus four 768x448 fixed corner-anchored overlapping tiles at original image resolution, each processed at960, class-car. Tile translations exact. Keep every preassigned fullframe reference untouched, add only previously missing references from tile detections fixed IoU>=.5; require cross-source duplicate IoU<.7 to each already selected fullframe owner box, one-to-one. D identical tile settings with all classes, diagnosis only. No manual crop centered on target and no threshold tuning. Every paired method has equal archived future frames; one conditional pastGT reference-box matching evaluator.
scope: Conditional ability to provide an initial observation and follow its mask. No tracker, no new core calls. Component-specific speed not an integrated benchmark.
